### The Philistines Reject David
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/philistines-reject-david
Passage: 1 Samuel 29:11
Points:
- David was trapped in a compromising predicament after living deceitfully among the Philistines.
- Suspicious Philistine commanders demanded that Achish send David away rather than let him join the battle.
- God provided David a providential way of escape before he was forced to fight against Israel.
- Even when Scripture does not explicitly name God, His invisible hand directs human affairs.
- Believers can be confident that the Lord quietly orchestrates all circumstances for their good.
